name: v4.0.544
body:
## What's Changed

- `remotion`: Validate props against the composition `schema` during rendering by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13317
- `remotion`: Preserve subtrees when toggling loop and motion blur by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13381
- `remotion`: Keep `cancelRender()` fatal after releasing render holds by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13353
- `remotion`: Restore `<HtmlInCanvas>` premounting on fixed Chromium by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13395
- `remotion`: Recover effects from initial WebGL context allocation failure by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13400
- [`@remotion/lambda`: Allow deploying via Terraform](https://remotion.dev/docs/lambda/terraform) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13308
- `@remotion/studio`: [Add OpenTimeline export option](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/export-opentimeline) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13334
- `@remotion/studio`: See all guides at once in the inspector by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13324
- `@remotion/studio`: Make Settings and Elements fullscreen by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13335
- `@remotion/animation-utils`: Fix multi-keyframe loops in `interpolateStyles()` by @adityajai119 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13364
- `@remotion/cli`: Fix `--license-key=free-license` being rejected by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13318
- `@remotion/cli`: Fail with composition list instead of hanging on picker without a TTY by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13321
- `@remotion/cli`: Fix still image format for uppercase file extensions by @adityajai119 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13409
- `@remotion/fonts`: Fix `loadFont()` format detection for URLs with query strings by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13304
- `@remotion/google-fonts`: Add Agrave Pro and Firjar
- `@remotion/install-whisper-cpp`: Reject downloads that end before `Content-Length` by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13248
- `@remotion/lambda`: Keep writing chunk status after a failed write, send one final webhook by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13301
- `@remotion/lambda`: Declare mime-types as a runtime dependency by @keiffff in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13351
- `@remotion/lambda-client`: Check payload size in sync and streaming invocations by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13067
- `@remotion/lambda-client`: Fix `expressWebhook()` skipping callbacks with `express.raw()` by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13316
- `@remotion/lambda-go`: Fix `storageClass` and `isProduction` being dropped from the render payload by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13249
- `@remotion/layout-utils`: Add `fontVariantNumeric` to `measureText()` cache key by @adityajai119 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13358
- `@remotion/lottie`: Fix empty first frame of `<Lottie direction="backward">` by @adityajai119 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13405
- `@remotion/lottie`: Fix `getLottieMetadata()` duration for animations that don't start at frame 0 by @adityajai119 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13407
- `@remotion/media`: Upgrade Mediabunny to 1.66.0 by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13398
- `@remotion/media`: Include package licenses and validate them in CI by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13337
- `@remotion/paths`: Fix `getBoundingBox()` leaving out a `T` curve after an arc by @adityajai119 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13368
- `@remotion/renderer`: Show HTTP status in failed resource warning, redact cookies in headers by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13319
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix process staying alive after SIGTERM or SIGHUP during a render by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13320
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix `--metadata` rejecting values that contain `=` by @adityajai119 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13360
- `@remotion/renderer`: Close all server sockets when address metadata is unavailable by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13370
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix endless `delayRender()` retries when a frame times out by @b84330808 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13393
- `@remotion/shapes`: Fix `transformOrigin` and `instructions` of `makePolygon()` and `makeStar()` by @adityajai119 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13389
- `@remotion/shapes`: Fix `makeRect()` with a `cornerRadius` larger than half of a side by @adityajai119 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13391
- `@remotion/skills`: Add OpenTimelineIO export to `remotion-render` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13327
- `@remotion/skills`: Remove RiverReveal example and bundled data by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13340
- `@remotion/skills`: Show every package manager for the @remotion/paths install by @Ridwannurudeen in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13350
- `@remotion/studio`: Deselect easing handles on Escape and outside clicks by @rishabhknowss in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13161
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix effect sizing in picker thumbnails by @pcbeingused333 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13315
- `@remotion/studio`: Don't remove a browser render while its output is saving by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13387
- `@remotion/studio`: Preserve invalid JSON drafts across unchanged prop refreshes by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13428
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Fix SVG font selection from external CSS by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13038
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Fix blurred pixelated backgrounds in WebKit by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13311
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Fix registered fonts in SVG CDATA by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13322
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Reject cancelled renders while queued by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13362
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Fix offscreen drop shadows with modern CSS colors by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13397
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Fall back to timers when the keepalive Worker cannot start by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13402
- `create-video`: Time out stalled template downloads by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13414

## Elements

- Fix crash when Elements are shorter than their animations by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13385

## Templates

- `template-vibe-code`: Use synchronous codemod APIs by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13380

## Docs

- Clarify who needs a Remotion for Creators Seat by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12832
- Address the reader as "you" instead of "we" by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13288
- Expand MDX components in Markdown pages for agents by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13302
- Use `npx remotion skills add` as the skills install command by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13305
- Check that tables of contents list every sidebar page by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13323
- Fix spacing and line breaks in numbered steps by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13326
- Only use `<AvailableFrom>` badges in headings by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13330
- Add Trung Nguyen to experts directory by @devil131313 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13336
- Add Compatibility table to createEffectImplementation() and fix Example heading level by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13371
- Use one structure across CLI reference pages by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13372
- Use one structure across @remotion/shapes pages by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13373
- Sort @remotion/transitions pages and fix the version they are available from by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13374
- Use one structure across package index pages by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13375
- Use one template across effect pages by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13376
- Use one structure across Lambda API pages by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13377
- Use sentence case for option names by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13378
- Write core terms consistently, in sentence case by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13379
- Add Michael Aubry to Experts by @bluematter in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13382
- Rename Browser Studio to remotion.new by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13384

## Internal and Experimental

- [`@remotion/codemods`: Make all codemods synchronous and expose Studio edits](https://remotion.dev/docs/codemods/insert-basic-captions) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13380
- [`@remotion/codemods`: Replace `reorderEffect()` with batch `reorderEffects()`](https://remotion.dev/docs/codemods/reorder-effects) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13339
- Test changed web renderer tests for flakes on pull requests by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13187
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Move container and codec helpers to `WebRendererInternals` by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13303
- Retain Browser Studio ruler failure evidence by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13313
- Fix Browser Studio ruler paint-order hit tests by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13331
- Run Browser Studio in its own required CI job by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13343
- Stream web renderer progress during CI by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13352
- Fix category selection for shared docs tables of contents by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13355
- Reduce web renderer test runtime by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13369
- Consolidate browser shutdown tests by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13421
- Limit web-renderer test workers on small CI runners by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13427

## New Contributors

- @devil131313 made their first contribution in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13336

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/compare/v4.0.543...v4.0.544
